summary: FERC's Secretary issues an errata notice correcting the caption and footnote 10 of the E-11 ISO-NE show cause order so Vermont Electric Cooperative is listed among the non-jurisdictional Participating Transmission Owners.

points.point: The caption wrongly included Vermont Electric Cooperative, and footnote 10 omitted it.
points.quote: The caption in the order inadvertently included “Vermont Electric Cooperative, Inc.” and footnote 10 inadvertently omitted “Vermont Electric Cooperative, Inc.”

points.point: The notice deletes VEC from the caption and adds it to footnote 10.
points.quote: This errata notice hereby corrects the caption, as shown above, by deleting “Vermont Electric Cooperative, Inc.”

points.point: FERC keeps authority to review non-public-utility formula rates as part of ISO-NE's Tariff.
points.quote: the Commission retains the authority to review each entity’s formula rates as a component of ISO-NE’s Tariff in an order to show cause directed towards ISO-NE

throughLine.text: Corrects who counts as a Participating Transmission Owner that must respond to the E-11 show cause order; ISO-NE itself must still respond about non-public utilities' Tariff provisions.
